_note: Inbox Desk sender rules. Business domains, subject words and campaign wording only. No names of people, no phone numbers, no personal email addresses: this repo is PUBLIC. People who write from a personal address (a coach on Gmail, a client's own address) go in the private Notion page config notion.inbox_desk_settings, which the skill reads at run time (see tools/inbox_desk/settings.py). Patterns are Python regexes, matched case-insensitive. Domains match the sender's domain or any subdomain of it.
label: Desk/Done

campaign._note: The cold email engine (surven-carehome) sends from joey@<cold domain>. Replies are forwarded into Joey's Gmail as one-message threads, so a reply is recognized by who it went to, the campaign subjects, and the quoted original under it.
subjects: do you have an open room
hey are you in charge of this
quote_markers: how many rooms are open at
are you the right person for this at
reply no and i'll stop emailing
i built a free tool for senior living
close your file after this one
plan_offer_markers: if the plan would still be useful
thumbs up or down on the plan
tool_offer_markers: let you give it a try
home_patterns: (?:open rooms|rooms are open|rooms open) at (?P<home>[^?\n]{2,80}?) right now
have a friend call (?P<home>[^\n]{2,80}?) about a room
i'm not sure i can even help (?P<home>[^\n]{2,80}?) yet

google_voice._note: Google Voice email forwards. Texts from Joey's OWN business lines (the GHL numbers he tests with) are never answered from here: a reply would text that GHL number, and the HQ listener treats texts there as commands.
google_voice.subject: ^new (?:text message|voicemail|missed call|group message)
footer_cut: to respond to this text message
this email was sent to you because

client_automation_subjects: ^(?:your visit is (?:set|soon)|your new visit time|thanks for reaching out|new .{0,40}lead!?|.*\b(?:send|reply) test\b|your fax|faxzero|private and shared rooms this week)

automation.self_subjects: ^(?:morning sales brief|(?:agc |splendor )?follow-up plan|data sale:|inbox desk:|google account for|hq desk|client desk|call engine)

noise._note: Everything not matched above is noise. A message that looks like a real person in the Primary tab is kept as noise/unknown_person and shown to Joey in the digest, never ignored.
noise.subjects: ^(?:invitation:|updated invitation|invitation from an unknown sender|accepted:|declined:|canceled event|cancelled event|notes:|recap of your meeting|your receipt|receipt|payment (?:received|confirmation)|order (?:confirmation|#)|verify your|confirm your email|sign in to|security alert|new sign-in)
